content: Diligent Engine separates device/context creation (IEngineFactoryVk::CreateDeviceAndContextsVk) from swapchain creation (CreateSwapChainVk) -- swapchain is optional and only needed for on-screen presentation. Tutorial12_RenderTarget demonstrates rendering to an offscreen render target. This is architecturally consistent with genuine headless operation, though no single official 'fully headless, zero window system' sample was found confirming zero platform-window-system touch points on Linux.
